target: Teach another learner to reason about continual rl protocols using a changing-environment RL schedule. Limit adaptation to a declared small example budget.

competency.title: Teach continual rl protocols — few shot
competency.outcome: Teach another learner to reason about continual rl protocols using a changing-environment RL schedule. Limit adaptation to a declared small example budget.

topic_kernel.measure: return, regret and retention over task order
topic_kernel.failure_to_detect: reusing a fixed task order as the holdout

competency.practice_task: Produce a lesson, coached exercise and blind learner transfer test grounded in a changing-environment RL schedule.
competency.setting_constraint: Limit adaptation to a declared small example budget.
required_evidence: a lesson, coached exercise and blind learner transfer test
Include the example count, selection rule and learning curve.
Report return, regret and retention over task order with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: reusing a fixed task order as the holdout.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of continual rl protocols.
Practice: the learner succeeds on a new case without the answer key.
Measurement: report return, regret and retention over task order against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for reusing a fixed task order as the holdout; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
